summary: P2 WS-2 host-aware project skill export for AlembicPlugin: use the accepted P0 finding that Claude Code project skills load from .claude/skills while Codex remains .agents/skills, then route project-skill export and write-prefix authorization through the host adapter without changing public tool contracts.
sourceRef: Design/docs/current/alembic-proactive-activation-2026-07-03.md §10.2 §10.6; controller review evidence p0-plugin-cc-skill-discovery-usage-baseline; accepted P1/P1b Plugin/Core/Alembic reviews.
designIntent: Implement the recommended architecture path: L3 HostAdapter.projectSkillRoot(projectRoot), Codex path byte-stable, Claude Code path from P0 proof, and PathGuard prefix coupling updated with the same host-aware root.

targetTasks.summary: Read AGENTS.md, the state root, AlembicPlugin/AGENTS.md, Design/docs/current/alembic-proactive-activation-2026-07-03.md §10.2/§10.6, and controller evidence for P0/P1/P1b before editing. Implement only P2 WS-2 host-aware project skill export: add or extend the L3 host adapter contract so projectSkillRoot(projectRoot) returns Codex .agents/skills unchanged and Claude Code .claude/skills per the accepted P0 proof; make getProjectSkillRoot and all ProjectSkillDelivery/ProjectSkillService export sites delegate to that adapter instead of hard-coding .agents/skills; update the coupled PathGuard project write prefix from the same host-aware root so Claude Code export is not blocked. Preserve public receipt field names such as codexSkillRoot if frozen by Core contracts, but set their values to the real host-specific root. Keep host-name branching inside the host-adapter layer; do not implement WS-6 cold-start auto-sync, WS-3 onboarding, or further wording/managed-block changes. Acceptance evidence: commit hash and file list; tests proving Codex export path and generated bytes stay unchanged, Claude Code resolves/exports to .claude/skills, both ProjectSkillDelivery and ProjectSkillService paths use the adapter, PathGuard allows the selected host skill prefix and rejects unrelated prefixes, four-tool/MCP output contracts stay unchanged, build/check pass, and risks/next-phase recommendation for P2b.
